seoTitle: Add an Image Carousel in Squarespace With Anchor Links
metaDescription: Build a moving image carousel in Squarespace using the Slideshow Reel layout, sized to fit your page cleanly.
intro: An image carousel adds visual movement to a Squarespace page and works well for photography or product showcases. This guide covers creating an image gallery section, switching it to a carousel-style layout, and sizing it to fit your page.

steps.heading: Log in and enter edit mode
steps.body: Sign in to Squarespace, select the website you want to update, and click the edit option to enter the editing interface.

steps.heading: Add an Images section
steps.body: Click Add Section, choose Images, then select Gallery view to open settings tailored for image presentations.

steps.heading: Switch to Slideshow Reel
steps.body: Click Edit Section, then instead of Grid Simple, select Slideshow Reel to turn your static images into a moving carousel.

steps.heading: Adjust the carousel width
steps.body: Set the width option, such as Insert, so the carousel fits comfortably within your page without awkward overlaps.

steps.heading: Save and review
steps.body: Save your changes and revisit the settings anytime to tweak visuals and better align the carousel with your site design.

faq.question: What layout turns images into a moving carousel?
faq.answer: Selecting Slideshow Reel instead of Grid Simple in the gallery section settings creates the carousel effect.

faq.question: Can I control how wide the carousel appears on the page?
faq.answer: Yes, the width option under the section settings, such as Insert, lets you fit the carousel to your page layout.

faq.question: Can I add jump links to specific carousel images?
faq.answer: You can add anchor links within your page to let visitors jump directly to the carousel section from elsewhere on the site.

faq.question: Do I need to re-upload images if I switch layouts later?
faq.answer: No, switching between grid and carousel layouts uses the same uploaded images — only the display style changes.
